mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, increasing present value of future earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 460 thousand units signal strengthening consumer demand and construction activity, boosting corporate revenue expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 460.0 but SPX 5-day returns negative in >55% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in industrial production indicates labor market tightening and manufacturing expansion, jointly driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE falls and INDPRO rises but SPX 60-day returns negative in >55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 0.50% during monetary tightening cycles increases discount rates and reduces liquidity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 0.50% but SPX 20-day returns positive in >55% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over last 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales above 330,000 million dollars indicate robust consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: RSAFS > 330,000 million but SPX 20-day returns negative in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 95.0 index points signals manufacturing contraction and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 95.0 but SPX 5-day returns positive in >55% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL above 213.0 and FEDFUNDS below 0.20% indicates inflationary pressure with accommodative policy, jointly driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 213.0 and FEDFUNDS < 0.20% but SPX 60-day returns negative in >55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.0% during high labor slack periods indicates weak consumer spending and earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 7.0% but SPX 20-day returns positive in >55% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over last 3 years.
